name: Waldcafe
beschreibung: The Waldcafe enjoys a quiet location on the edge of a Tyrolean mountain village, surrounded by forests and meadows. The interior combines alpine cosiness with modern comfort – wood panelling, warm colour tones, and large windows define the welcoming ambiance. Guests can look forward to spacious rooms, a restaurant serving regional cuisine, and a sun terrace with mountain views. In winter, there is direct access to ski slopes, while summer offers hiking trails right from the doorstep. Families and nature lovers will find an uncomplicated alpine retreat here.
